text.p: German media group Bertelsmann AG on Friday denied a magazine report it planned to merge its Premiere pay-per-view channel with the DF1 satellite venture of mogul Leo Kirch.

The scenario described by Werben & Verkaufen, an advertising trade magazine, was "pulled completely out of the air and possibly was influenced by the unrealistic wishes" of Kirch, Bertelsmann chief executive Michael Dornemann said.
"Premiere absolutely stands in the middle of our pay-TV activities, and that has not changed," he said.
Separately Premiere also denied the report, saying a merger of the channels "was not in sight."
W&V said the two were talking about making Premiere into a movie-only channel using Kirch's vast film library, while DF1 would become a sport channel, using Bertelsmann's rights to German soccer.
DF1 has struggled to gain subscribers since its launch last fall. Kirch recently negotiated a package of one billion marks in credits from a group of banks.
